items.title: Lucky Block
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Lucky Blocks are everywhere and spawn naturally! Test your luck and beware of unlucky outcomes!

+ Survive in a custom spawn!

items.title: Ore Teens
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Would you like to be a glimmering diamond, an iridescent emerald, or a chiseled hunk of coal? Now, you can be any ore of your choosing! If your current skin is making you a diamond with a rough outfit, these skins will polish you right up. Ore teens will have you shining in no time!

- 9 Ore Themed Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Skyblock Lucky Block
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: On this sky world, you will find giant lucky blocks everywhere. Explore all it's secrets and try your luck!

items.title: Medieval Expansion
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Expand your world with a medieval world expansion!

items.title: I'm a Horse
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Ever feel like just horsing around? Want to look just like your noble steed? This is your chance! Take on the look of one of the most popular ways to travel the overworld! Though you might not be able to carry another player, you’ll for sure feel like an equestrian legend!

items.title: Western Horse Riders
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Kick up some dust with this Western Horse Riders skin pack. Make a statement in the equestrian world by wearing one of these colorful outfits. We'll see you at the rodeo!

items.title: Mountain Wedding
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: The rustic charm of the mountains makes for a perfect wedding destination. These skins are perfect if you love the outdoors. Download this pack for your next wedding roleplay.

items.title: Anime Fantasy
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Do you have a fantasy of living the anime dream? This skin pack allows you to do just that! Roleplay in cute fashion inspired by anime!

items.title: Breakfast
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Do you like breakfast? Well, wear your favorite breakfast items with this quirky skin pack! Crunchy bacon, juicy strawberries, sweet orange juice - you can be them all!

items.title: By the Sea
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Are you ready to sea some amazing skins? Dive into the ocean as your favorite sea creature. Become a Kraken or a fierce pirate!

+ 8 aqua themed skins
+ Perfect for an underwater adventure
+ FREE SKIN: Pirate Penny

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Modern Resort
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Welcome to The Modern Resort! An adventure island full of fun activities to keep guests entertained all summer! Explore the fully furnished modern mansion, drop by the water park, play mini-games & seize everything the resort has to offer! 

+ 2 parkour challenges
+ 1 maze
+ Fly planes
+ Ride jet skis
+ Race around the go-kart track
+ By MinecraftWorkshop & inPixel

items.title: Fashion Legends
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Improve your fashion game by grabbing this latest trendy skin pack! Become the legend you were always meant to be no matter who you are and show off to your Minecraft friends with your colorful and cute outfits! No matter your style preference you will find something in here worth your attention!

- 14 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Clean Style
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Tired of seeing trendy hype beast skins? Want something clean, modern, and stylish? This pack is just for you! Perfect for those who love minimalistic designs and want to stand out from the crowd in a different way! 

- 12 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Monsters and Aliens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description: Monsters and Aliens are coming to haunt you this Halloween. Dress up and prepare to scare your friends.

items.title: Demon School
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
All demons need to go to school to learn to be bad. So why not go to Demon School!

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Cute and casual attire inspired by fictions!

items.title: Cute Mobs
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Ever wanted to cuddle a rotten zombie, or the creeper heading to your house? No? Well then, take a look at these guys!
Who would have thought hostile mobs could be this adorable?

+ Includes a free wither skeleton
+ 16 mobs
+ By LuckOfTheSea

items.title: Hacker Base
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Hacker Base is a secret underground base with the most powerful gear in Minecraft. Danger is around every corner, but these items can make you a legend! Explore the base and discover all the hacked items! 

- Modern base design
- Hacked armor, weapons, and blocks!
- Tons of decorated rooms!
- Play with friends!

items.title: Lucky Skyblock Dragonslayer
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
There be dragons, but never fear! Lucky blocks are here! Test your luck by opening lucky blocks to gather your gear and survive in this world! Are you ready?

- 10 lucky blocks!
- Over 100 different events!
- Custom massive skyblock spawn!

items.title: Robot Demons
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
The future has arrived, and with that comes new fashion trends! With the Robot Demons pack, you can have fun as a demon and cruise around town with your friends!

- 10 skins
- By Street Studios

items.title: Mountain Parkour & Droppers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Ready for a crazy fun challenge? Make your way up the mountain in a challenging and thrilling parkour course. Overcome various unique obstacles, pass multiple biomes, collect wearable hats, find mystery boxes and master your parkour skills.

=> Multiple themes, levels and biomes
=> Challenging dropper levels
=> Boosts & bonuses
=> Wearables collectibles
=> HD skins inside

items.title: Crimson Dragon Village
items.creator: BTWN Creations
items.description:
Immerse yourself in a village with rich history! Enjoy village life in a charming setting while you gear up to discover the dragon cave and fight your way through the deadly stronghold. Does the dragon guardian watch over the village or protect you from the danger below the surface?

- Over 30 unique buildings and interiors
- Custom stronghold with end portal
- by BTWN

items.title: Guards & Robbers
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Spy over your friends, keep the robbers away as a police officer or rob a bank as a mastermind. A lot of unique possibilities to choose from, with this incredible Guards & Robbers skin pack!

- 8 detailed skins to roleplay with!
- Lots of fun!

items.title: Professions
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Want to pursue your dream career, right now? Enjoy this beautiful set of professions and bring your favourite jobs to every world of yours!

*8 exclusive skins!
*Dreams come true with these great teens!

items.title: Warriors
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Have you ever thought about becoming a great warrior and protecting your kingdom? This is your chance to lead everyone to a prosperous future!

+ 8 warrior skins!
+ All formidable and unstoppable!
